name: Cosmic Suppression
body:
Your mastery of spiritual arts paves the way to leveraging the inner workings of body and spirit to cause a drastic imbalance in another creature.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, Cosmic Cycling, and 15 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic suppression ability.

Cosmic Suppression (Su)

Once per day, as a standard action, you may make a melee touch attack on a target creature. On a successful hit, the target creature must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failure, the target is forced to use their lowest ability score in lieu of any one of their other ability scores of your choice. Once this choice is made, the effect lasts a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD. See Cosmic Cycling for how statistics and checks are affected in this manner.

A creature can only be under the effects of one use of cosmic suppression at any given time.

Special: You may expend 4 ki points or 4 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic suppression. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic suppression in this way once for every 7 HD you possess.
